description.value: Pizza Junction & Snacks is a fast-food pizza restaurant on George Ferguson Way in Abbotsford, offering made-to-order pizzas, salads, wings, and fresh juice. The menu features a broad range of options from classic cheese to specialty meat lovers, along with a dedicated 100% vegetarian section built around paneer, tofu, and veg specials. Online and phone ordering make it a practical hot-meal stop for cyclists passing through the Abbotsford corridor.
